title: Welcome to Silvermoon City!

From artists practicing their crafts to profession trainers and vendors; adventurers will find just what they need. Whether you’re seeking a respite from the press of the Void or simply passing through, it’s all here.

title: Take on New PvP Challenges in Midnight
summary: In Midnight, players can take on new player versus player (PvP) challenges in the Slayer’s Rise battleground, outdoor World PvP objectives in the Voidstorm, and Training Grounds to help you get your PvP legs underneath you.

title: WoW Weekly: Housing on the PTR, Hallow's End Begins, and More!
summary: Check out Housing Early Access on the PTR, haul in ghoulish delights and take on the Headless Horseman in the Hollow's End in-game holiday event, and more! Every week brings thrilling new adventures and loot, so rally your allies and forge your legend in Azeroth.

title: Housing 101: Getting Started

title: The Mythic Dungeon International Returns October 24!
summary: Prepare for broken records and crowned champions —MDI Season 3 is here!

title: World of Warcraft®: Midnight™ Goes Live 2 March!
summary: Prepare to face Xal’atath, the Harbinger and the Void in World of Warcraft®: Midnight™ launching worldwide on 2 March, 2026 at 23:00 GMT. Players who have purchased any edition of the Midnight expansion can secure Housing Early Access starting 3 December 2025.

title: Pull Up a Chair in the Arcantina
summary: A refuge to the road-weary and those seeking a respite from the trials and travails of an adventurer’s life, the Arcantina in Midnight serves as a crossway for all kinds. Here you’ll reunite with some familiar faces, share stories, and take on new quests that send you all over Azeroth and beyond.

title: Class Tuning, Updates, and What to Expect in Midnight

Before we turn the page on your next adventures, you’ll want to complete activities from around Khaz Algar before many of their rewards are no longer available when the pre-expansion content update goes live on 21 January.

summary: The Warning content update arrives to World of Warcraft on 3 December!

title: Legion Remix Housing Decor Now Available
summary: Players can now collect Legion Remix Housing decor to use when decorating their new home in Azeroth. If you’re looking to add a touch of Fel green to the ambiance, then look no further. We’ve got you covered.

title: Cuddle Up with the Plushie Decor Pack

title: Midnight Pre-Expansion Content Update Notes
summary: The Midnight Pre-Expansion content update is now live!

title: Tune in Now for the State of Azeroth
summary: Join Executive Producer Holly Longdale and Senior Game Director Ion Hazzikostas once more on the official World of Warcraft YouTube and Twitch channels as they give you a glimpse into what the future holds for Azeroth and more.

title: Professions Unpacked: Craft Housing Decor with Reagents from Every Era
summary: Adventurers, your banks and bags are about to get lighter! With the arrival of “The Warning” content update, reagents you’ve stashed since Classic World of Warcraft—right up through The War Within—have a renewed purpose. Crafters can transform their collections of herbs, ores, leathers, and more into unique Housing decor items.

summary: Embark on an auditory journey through the sounds of the Midnight expansion as you embrace the Light and slip through the shadows of the Void. You’ll rediscover familiar themes and encounter new ones orchestrated to sweep you away into adventure.

You’ll also find more room to play with increased house levels, new Artisanal Rooms, added decor categories, expanded dye options, and more ways to make your home feel unmistakably yours.

summary: The September Trading Post Outlet closes soon! Get in your last purchases before the vendors change over to their October inventory.

summary: Watch any eligible World of Warcraft stream on Twitch.tv or on the official World of Warcraft YouTube channel to claim a bucket full of rewards.

summary: Get ready to welcome four new groups of visitors to your neighborhood with the introduction of new Endeavors featuring the Amani trolls, kobolds, Ohn’ahran centaur, and tortollan. Take on new activities, earn more Community Coupons, and shop for new Housing Decor items—including rugs—to enhance your home.

summary: With the Curse of Ula’tek content update, players can link their Battle.net and Discord accounts to chat and collaborate with their guild no matter where they are.

title: Bloom Bright with the Vibrant Petalweave Collection
summary: Celebrate the season in flowing floral finery woven with the vibrant colors of summer. From sunlit strolls to magical midsummer nights, the Vibrant Petalweave Collection is ready to help your style take root on every adventure.

title: Set Out with the Hearthkeeper’s Wandering Caravan Mount
summary: Bring comfort and convenience on every ox-pedition with the Hearthkeeper’s Wandering Caravan, a handy ground mount equipped with repair and mailbox access wherever your journey takes you.

summary: This week in WoW Weekly, brave the depths of the Venomous Abyss raid, follow top guilds as they compete in the Race to World First, and jump into a new season of challenges, rewards, and adventures as Midnight Season 2 begins.

title: WoW Roofus Pack Raises More Than $1.3M for Habitat for Humanity
summary: Thanks to the World of Warcraft community, the Roofus Pack raised more than $1.3 million USD for Habitat for Humanity, turning an in-game companion and cozy Housing Decor into real-world support for families and communities.

title: Black Temple, The Venomous Abyss, and More in This Week’s WoW Weekly
summary: This week in WoW Weekly, Black Temple is now live in Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition, Story Mode and Raid Finder Wing 2 have opened in The Venomous Abyss, September’s Trading Post celebrates friendship with new rewards, the Northrend Cup returns, and more adventures await across Azeroth.

title: Collect Trader’s Tender in Midnight’s Winds of Mysterious Fortune
summary: The forecast calls for fortune! Log in during the Winds of Mysterious Fortune event to earn Trader’s Tender, collect Mysterious Satchels, and breeze through your adventures with bonus experience and reputation gains.

title: BlizzCon 2026, Midnight 12.1.5, and More in This Week’s WoW Weekly
summary: This week’s WoW Weekly roundup spotlights BlizzCon 2026, including livestream festivities, in-game rewards, and the return of the AWC and MDI Grand Finals, alongside new Midnight adventures, Raid Finder updates, and the WoW Roofus Pack charity milestone for Habitat for Humanity.

title: World of Warcraft: Midnight What’s Next Panel Recap
summary: The World of Warcraft team took to the stage at BlizzCon 2026 to reveal Talebound, share updates on the next chapter of Midnight, including content update 12.1.5 and Eclipse, and offer a look at what’s ahead for Midnight Season 3, Housing, and beyond.

summary: Join Host Countdown To Classic, Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Principal Game Designer Kris Zierhut, and Senior Game Designer Aidan Moon, with special guest and content creator Sodapoppin.

title: World of Warcraft at BlizzCon 2026 News Round-Up
summary: BlizzCon 2026 has come to a close, and we’ve gathered the latest World of Warcraft announcements, reveals, and updates from the weekend in one place. Catch up on everything shared during the show right here.

title: Pre-Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades and Begin Your Next Journey in Azeroth
summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

title: Wage War Once More with Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom
summary: Return to the battlefields that shaped Azeroth with Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom, an all-new campaign that bridges the story from The Frozen Throne to the first days of World of Warcraft. Purchase the Forsaken Kingdom campaign on the Battle.net Shop on its own or choose from additional options that include Warcraft III: Reforged, the Forsaken Kingdom combo, and the Warcraft Forever Collection.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever GPU Requirements
summary: When World of Warcraft: Forever launches GPUs based on certain older graphics architectures that fall well below the game's minimum hardware requirements will no longer be supported. The vast majority of World of Warcraft players already use compatible hardware, and this change will allow us to support the game’s updated visual look while providing a more consistent experience for players.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives — Priest and Warrior
summary: Priests and Warriors are next in our World of Warcraft: Forever class deep dives, with updates that build on the roles, rhythms, and class-defining tools players know. This look covers new and adjusted baseline abilities, refreshed racial Priest spells, Rage and stance updates for Warriors, and talent changes across Discipline, Holy, Shadow, Arms, Fury, and Protection.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives — Hunter and Druid
summary: Answer the call of the wild and take on nature’s many forms in World of Warcraft: Forever. We’re sharing Development Team insights on Hunter and Druid, including how these classes are evolving through talent updates, class-defining abilities, and new ways to play.

title: Choose Your Ruleset in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is taking a new approach to where and how players begin their journey. Instead of choosing from a long list of realms, players will select a ruleset—Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, or Hardcore—that matches how they want to experience Azeroth. Each option operates as its own large ecosystem for grouping, dungeons, raids, and community, with Hardcore joining the available lineup sometime after launch.

title: WoW: Forever Meet the New Skyborne
summary: The Skyborne—also known as the shen’dorei, or hidden people—are a new playable race in World of Warcraft: Forever. Their journey begins on Zephras Isle, a level 1–12 starting experience that blends classic Warcraft aesthetics with elemental architecture and a story shaped by wind and ancestry. At character creation, you’ll choose whether your Skyborne joins the proud Horde or the noble Alliance.

title: Carve a New Path with World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: Catch up on everything announced for World of Warcraft: Forever during BlizzCon, including a first look at the next chapter for Azeroth and the adventures waiting on the horizon.

title: Watch the World of Warcraft Live Q&A Now
summary: The World of Warcraft Q&A is now available to watch, with members from the modern World of Warcraft and WoW Forever development teams answering community questions following the reveals of BlizzCon 2026.

title: Tales Take a Dark Turn in Midnight’s Talebound
summary: Step into Midnight’s Talebound, a PvE action RPG game mode where macabre stories come to life. Venture solo or with friends through eerie tales filled with enemies, bosses, puzzles, treasure, relics, and cosmetic rewards as you confront the terrors waiting beyond Quillgrave.

title: Raise Your Stein! Brewfest Returns with Battle-Brewed Rewards
summary: Eat delicious food, drink bountiful beverages, ride rams around barrels of apples, and earn stout rewards! Brewfest has arrived, and you can enjoy all that and more from 20 September to 6 October.

title: Submit Your Questions for the World of Warcraft Live Q&A 17 September
summary: Have a question about what you learned at BlizzCon 2026 after the show reveals? We're collecting your questions and hosting a live Q&A with members of the World of Warcraft modern and Forever development teams to answer as many as we can on 17 September.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Deep Dive Panel Recap
summary: Missed the World of Warcraft: Forever Deep Dive? Associate Production Director Clay Stone, Senior Game Designer Josh Greenfield, Lead Software Engineer Ana Resendez, and Principal Game Designer Kris Zierhut shared a closer look at the systems shaping the game, including Camping, Legacy System progression, combat updates, and more.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Headlines a Packed WoW Weekly
summary: Get to know World of Warcraft: Forever through our latest articles on choosing your ruleset, naming your character, class and race combinations, the new Skyborne race, and the Legacy System, then watch episode 1 of the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast. You can also look ahead to October’s Trading Post and catch up on the Brewfest in-game holiday, what’s happening in the WoW Portal Room, and more in WoW Weekly.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever What’s Next Panel Recap
summary: For years, players have wondered what new adventures could still unfold in original Azeroth. During the What’s Next panel, Senior Game Director Ion Hazzikostas, Lead Classic Designer Tim Jones, Lead Software Engineer Nora Mills, and Associate Production Director Clay Stone shared how that dream is taking shape in World of Warcraft: Forever, from new regions and dungeons to raids, systems, the new playable Skyborne race, and the road ahead.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Found Photos Panel Recap
summary: Senior Game Designer Josh Greenfield and Lead Content Designer Evan Lee shared how original Azeroth’s forgotten corners, unfinished threads, and long-held player memories helped inspire World of Warcraft: Forever. Learn how the team is expanding the level 1–60 experience with reimagined regions, quests, characters, locations, and stories that build on original Azeroth.

title: Blizzcon 2026, WoW Forever Beta, Midnight S3, and More in This Week’s Wow Weekly
summary: This week’s WoW Weekly roundup spotlights BlizzCon 2026 and the latest World of Warcraft announcements, including World of Warcraft: Forever, answers to community questions from our modern WoW and WoW Forever live Q&A, a peek at the Midnight Season 3 Dungeon pool, and more!

summary: Explore the playable races, class combinations, and updated racial traits coming in World of Warcraft: Forever, including new options for familiar favorites along with the introduction of the Skyborne.

title: The World of Warcraft: Forever Beta Now Live
summary: The World of Warcraft: Forever beta begins September 17 and is available through October 21. Opt in for a chance to join testing, or gain beta access by purchasing eligible World of Warcraft: Forever bundles, then share your feedback as we prepare for launch on November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST.

title: Create a Name of Your Own in WoW: Forever
summary: In World of Warcraft: Forever, every character name is an opportunity to express yourself and establish your identity in Azeroth. With the addition of two names, players have more room to create something personal while keeping each full name unique within a region. That means you may still be able to use the same first name as another character, but your complete two-name combination is unique to you.

summary: Read all the changes that are coming in the 12.1.5 content update.

title: Take a Dip into the Midnight Season 3 Dungeon Pool Preview

title: Midnight’s 12.1.5 Content Update Arrives 14 October
